note: The code-owned registry is authoritative; each assessment must carry an exact catalog identity and be attributed to the single specialist assigned to that category. Agent-supplied availability cannot promote concepts. With 357 catalog-only entries, actionable handoff intentionally remains blocked. Live execution is never authorized. Work plans are stored in a bounded durable SQLite registry for 15 minutes, consumed exactly once through an atomic write transaction, and rejected if modified, expired, or replayed. Each consumed plan creates a durable attempt record; completed results persist the submitted assessments and audit receipt before returning. Native commands re-read the Rust-owned provider snapshot and account risk preflight. This does not replace the order-specific paper-order risk gateway. Schema v3 adds append-only specialist dispatch receipts cross-linked to the durable audit chain. Receipt rows are not exposed as a frontend command. Current providerDispatchConfigured=false means no real specialist runtime is configured; receipt requirements intentionally block completion rather than infer dispatch from a work plan or prompt.
